{{Quote|Too dark to see my breakfast, it is. Perhaps lucky, I am, hmm.|Yoda comments on the unpleasantness of the stew|<ref name="Rebel Force: Hostage">''[[Rebel Force: Hostage]]''</ref>}}
'''Butcherbug stew''' was a type of [[Stew/Legends|stew]] made from the meat of the [[Butcherbug/Legends|butcherbug]], an [[Insect/Legends|insect]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].<ref name="Rebel Force: Hostage" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]&ndash;a member of a [[Yoda's species/Legends|mysterious green-skinned species]]&ndash;made the stew for breakfast while he lived in exile on Dagobah, although he found the smell of the dish foul. The Jedi stirred [[Rootleaf/Legends|rootleaf]] and [[Gnarltree/Legends|gnarltree]] bark into the stew before eating it, and while dining he was contacted by the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="Rebel Force: Hostage" />

==Behind the scenes==
Butcherbug stew first appeared in the [[Book/Legends|novel]] ''[[Rebel Force: Hostage]]'' which was written by [[Alex Wheeler]] and released in [[2009]].
